study_identification_part.si4_title: Structural variability of the cerebral cortex in schizophrenia and its association with clinical symptoms

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Quantify global and regional variability of cortical morphometry in schizophrenia using CV and PBSI across 308 ROIs, and test associations of PBSI-derived deviations with symptoms and cognition (IQ).

rci1_dataset_name.answer: AMC; JNUH; COBRE; NMorphCH; MCIC; fBIRN; UCLA (OpenNeuro ds000030)
rci1_dataset_name.reason: Methods list seven contributing datasets: two hospital cohorts (AMC, JNUH) and five public datasets (COBRE, NMorphCH, MCIC, fBIRN, UCLA).
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: We included neuroimaging datasets acquired from two tertiary hospitals ... AMC and JNUH. From the SchizConnect database ... we obtained COBRE, NMorphCH, MCIC, and fBIRN. ... UCLA ... downloaded from OpenNeuro (ds000030).

rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: Methods. We used neuroimaging data from 420 healthy controls and 695 patients with SCZ from seven studies.

rci5_imaging_modality.reason: Image analysis is described on T1-weighted structural images processed in FreeSurfer.
rci5_imaging_modality.supporting_text: We obtained T1-weighted images ... Image analysis was performed using the FreeSurfer (version 7.1) automated pipeline ... with the local GI command for the local gyrification index.

rci6_analysis_level.supporting_text: ... we applied an atlas with 308 cortical regions derived from the Desikan–Killiany atlas. Four morphometric features across 308 cortical structures were calculated ...

rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.answer: FreeSurfer v7.1; local GI (Schaer 2008); 308-region parcellation derived from Desikan–Killiany; Yeo and von Economo subnetworks used for PBSI summaries
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.reason: Paper specifies FreeSurfer version, local gyrification index computation, and the parcellation scheme; subnetworks used for stratified PBSI.
rci7_preprocessing_pipeline.supporting_text: Image analysis was performed using the FreeSurfer (version 7.1) automated pipeline ... with the local GI command ... we applied an atlas with 308 cortical regions derived from the Desikan–Killiany atlas ... The Yeo and von Economo atlases were used to categorize the cortical structures into separate subnetworks.

rci8_quality_checking.detail: Outlier rule: per measure outside mean ±3.5 SD; exclude participants with >8 total outliers across 4×308 measures; validate age/sex matching post-exclusion; subsample in fBIRN and UCLA via MatchIt (R).
rci8_quality_checking.supporting_text: We excluded participants with the total number of identified outliers higher than 8 (the 3rd quartile + 3 × interquartile range). ... subsampled patients with schizophrenia and healthy controls matched for age and sex using the MatchIt package in R-CRAN.

rci9_site_effect_handling.detail: ComBat harmonization by site across seven datasets; validation tables show site mean differences before/after ComBat for SA, GMV, CT, LGI; covariates described in supplement (age, sex, diagnosis).
rci9_site_effect_handling.supporting_text: We performed ComBat harmonization to adjust the site differences ... Supplementary Table 2-1/2-4 show site differences in mean cortical measures before and after ComBat harmonization.

nm2_modeling_method.answer: Person-Based Similarity Index (PBSI) using Spearman correlations of 308-ROI profiles; PBSI-All aggregates 4 modalities (SA, GMV, CT, LGI)
nm2_modeling_method.reason: Detailed PBSI computation procedure is described, including per-modality and all-measure profiles.
nm2_modeling_method.supporting_text: In each group, the cortical structural profile of an individual correlated with the respective profiles of all other individuals within the same group using the Spearman's correlation coefficient rho ... averaged to generate the PBSI score ... PBSI-All using all cortical measures (4 × 308).

nm3_software_tool.answer: R v4.0.2; cvequality package (CV tests); custom R code for PBSI
nm3_software_tool.reason: R version and cvequality package are explicitly stated; PBSI implemented per published procedure (no specific package).
nm3_software_tool.supporting_text: All statistical analyses were performed using R software (ver. 4.0.2) ... Group differences in the CV were tested ... implemented in the cvequality package in R-CRAN.

nm4_response_variable.answer: Surface area; Gray matter volume; Cortical thickness; Local gyrification index (308 regions)
nm4_response_variable.reason: Four morphometric features across 308 cortical structures were analyzed.
nm4_response_variable.supporting_text: Four morphometric features across 308 cortical structures were calculated: surface area, gray matter volume, thickness, and local gyrification index.

nm5_predictor_variables.answer: NA for PBSI; ComBat covariates: Age; Sex; Diagnosis
nm5_predictor_variables.reason: PBSI does not model predictors; harmonization step used covariates.
nm5_predictor_variables.supporting_text: We performed ComBat harmonization ... with the covariates of age, sex, and diagnosis.

nm6_predictor_effects.reason: No fixed/random effects model is used for PBSI.

nm7_nm_vldtn_handle_ns.reason: Site effects reduced via ComBat and extreme values removed; age/sex matched. Authors note remaining site differences and that variations due to race/education/cognition were not included in harmonization.
nm7_nm_vldtn_handle_ns.supporting_text: We performed ComBat harmonization to adjust for site differences ... We excluded participants with the total number of identified outliers higher than 8 ... Although the site difference decreased after ComBat harmonization, some significant group differences in the mean cortical measures were noted. Second, we did not consider morphometric measure variations derived from different sample characteristics in terms of race, cognitive function, and education in the harmonization process.

nm8_nm_vldtn_same_domain_nonindep.supporting_text: To test the robustness of the PBSI score ... bootstrap resampling ... and a leave-one-out approach for contribution of each region.

caa6_deviation_metric.answer: PBSI z-scores; deviant patients defined as PBSI < (HC mean − 1.5 SD)
caa6_deviation_metric.reason: Supplement explicitly defines the deviant threshold relative to HC PBSI normative range.
caa6_deviation_metric.supporting_text: a Deviant patients were defined as those with PBSI scores lower than the mean-1.5 SD scores of healthy controls.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa7_association_analysis: Spearman correlations between PBSI (per modality and PBSI-All) and clinical variables (IQ, PANSS); Mann–Whitney U tests with Bonferroni correction for group comparisons; normative grouping (deviant vs other) compared on IQ and PANSS (Supplementary Tables 7-1, 7-2).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: SCZ shows greater cortical structural variability (higher CV, lower PBSI) than HCs; lower PBSI relates to lower IQ; deviant-PBSI patients exhibit reduced IQ.
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa9_key_findings_detailed: PBSI scores were lower in SCZ vs HC across all measures; in patients, PBSI-GV and PBSI-All positively correlated with IQ (e.g., table snippet shows rho≈0.197–0.256; p≈0.001–0.010). Normative grouping using HC mean−1.5SD indicated lower IQ in deviant patients (see Supplementary Tables 7-1, 7-2; e.g., PBSI-GV: W=2956.5, p<0.001; PBSI-All: W=2968.5, p=0.046).
clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa11_application_notes: Used fine 308-parcel scheme and included LGI alongside SA, GMV, CT; applied ComBat for site effects and explicit QC; stratified patients by PBSI deviation to relate to cognition.

caa10_key_limitations.answer: IQ available in a subset of patients; harmonization did not account for race/education/cognition; residual site differences remained after ComBat; cross-sectional design; limited cognitive battery; potential confounding by antipsychotic exposure.

general_note_part.gn1_general_notes: Seven datasets (AMC, JNUH, COBRE, NMorphCH, MCIC, fBIRN, UCLA). T1w processed via FreeSurfer v7.1 with local GI; 308-ROI parcellation derived from Desikan–Killiany; Yeo and von Economo subnetworks used in PBSI analyses. QC: outlier rule ±3.5 SD per ROI and >8 total outliers exclusion; post-QC age/sex matching with MatchIt.
